A companion app and family dashboard support item finding, remote assistance and communication."},{"id":"383:3419","t":"Goal"},{"id":"383:3420","t":"The goal is to support everyday independence while keeping assistance easy to understand and control. Clear feedback shows what the device is doing, while users decide when it approaches, pauses or requests help. Family members can stay informed through remote monitoring with the user’s permission."},{"id":"383:3421","t":"Through this project,
I explored how physical assistance and digital care can support independence while preserving privacy and choice."},{"id":"383:3422","t":"Physical prototype · Interface design

changes: NEARBY is a mobile assistive cabinet designed to keep everyday essentials within reach for older adults, including people living with dementia. It combines familiar storage, an adjustable tray and COME / STAY / HELP controls. A proposed app and family dashboard support item finding, remote assistance and communication.
